name: report_auth
label: Report Template Authorization Table
description: Report template authorization table used for associated queries related to report operations.

fields.name: report_id
fields.description: Report template ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Common: public user: user role: role team: team, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_uuid
fields.description: UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the report_id, type, auth_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the auth_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
